text:
lina: quick postmortem follow-up: multiple customers observed session drops + partial responses intermittently yesterday (~21:13-21:54 UTC). root cause hypothesis: ephemeral socket RTT spikes + client reconnect mismatch. creating an action tracker here. TL;DR: prioritize reconnect jitter, SLO updates, and visibility on partial chunks.

cruz: can you paste a quick log sample? we saw 502s and some WS close 1006.

lina: log snippet: 
```
[2025-05-12T21:23:10Z] conn=ab12 close=1006 reason="read timeout" rtt=250ms tokens=432
[2025-05-12T21:23:11Z] conn=ab13 partial_chunks=1 last_seq=34
```

devon: fwiw client backoff uses fixed 1s retry, no jitter. that will create a thundering herd on bursts. suggest exp backoff + jitter.

cruz: agreed. propose default client retry = exp(backoff, base 200ms, factor 2, max 8s) with full jitter. also server should send keepalive pings on idle 30s.

sree: happy to own server changes (keepalive + clearer close codes).

lina: assigned: sree -> server keepalive + improved close codes. @cruz -> SDK retry + jitter. devon -> telemetry & partial-chunk detection dashboard. timeline: cruz PR by 2025-05-16, sree canary 2025-05-18, devon dashboard by 2025-05-20.

paul: short-term mitigation: enable re-route to secondary region on 1006 after 2 retries. ops runbook will include this.

devon: I'll add dashboard tiles: ‘partial_chunk_rate’ and ‘session_reopens_per_min’ + alert at 0.1% above baseline.

lina: action items (compact):
1) SDK retry + jitter (cruz)
2) Server keepalive & close codes (sree)
3) Re-route fallback after 2 retries (paul)
4) Telemetry + alerts (devon)
5) Post-deploy smoke & canary (lina)
6) Update SLOs + customer comms (lina)

cruz: sample retry config I'll use: 
```
retry:
  base_ms: 200
  factor: 2
  max_ms: 8000
  jitter: full
  attempts: 5
```

opsbot: Created ticket INF-5589 and scheduled reminder on 2025-05-19 for canary review.

sree: quick note: we'll add close code 1013 for "server overloaded" so clients can fallback earlier.

lina: let's also run a 48h retrospective after fixes are in prod. recurring check: weekly stream-stability sync for 6 weeks. who wants rotation lead?

paul: I'll take rotation lead weeks 1-2.

cruz: I'll take weeks 3-4.

devon: I'll take weeks 5-6 and own alert tuning.

lina: thanks all. I'll update the postmortem doc with owners + deadlines and link to INF-5589. closing this thread unless something urgent pops up. :thumbsup:
